thinkingMap.title: Educational game for kids
thinkingMap.seedIdea: I want to build an educational game for kids, but I don't know what it should be.

message.content: I want to build an educational game for kids, but I don't know what it should be.
Before we think about the game itself: who is this actually for, what should they learn, and what are they doing today instead?
Probably kids around 6 to 8, and I want them to learn vocabulary.
Got it. I looked at what already exists for that age and skill, found three apps worth knowing about, and added them to the map. Two gaps stood out right away.

mapNode.label: No parent involvement
mapNode.detail: All three treat the child as the only user. Nobody surfaces what was learned to the adult who bought the app.

mapNode.label: Fixed difficulty level
mapNode.detail: Word lists are age-banded, not ability-banded, so a strong reader is bored within a week.
